institution.name: University of Copenhagen, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

qualifications: PhD awarded less than 8 years before the application deadline (leave periods can extend this)
PhD students may apply if the thesis will be defended before 1 September 2027
Not eligible: more than two years of postdoctoral employment at the University of Copenhagen before the fellowship starts
Apply together with a mentor team (basic biomedical scientist plus clinical or industry scientist)
description_short: The University of Copenhagen seeks 14 postdoctoral fellows in translational medicine for two-year appointments starting 1 September 2027. Fellows work mainly on individual translational projects, guided by a mentor team pairing a basic biomedical scientist with a clinical or industry scientist.
